sql_query:
WITH order_vals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_val
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
items_per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS items
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
reviews_per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS review_score
  FROM order_reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
),
cust_order_vals AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS custuid,
    o.order_id AS orderid,
    COALESCE(ov.order_val, 0.0) AS order_val
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN order_vals ov ON o.order_id = ov.order_id
)
SELECT
  cm.custuid AS cust,
  ROUND(cm.total_revenue, 2) AS total_rev,
  ROUND(cm.average_order_value, 2) AS avg_ord_val,
  cm.total_orders AS tot_orders,
  cm.total_items AS tot_items,
  ROUND(cm.average_review_score, 2) AS avg_rev_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    cov.custuid,
    SUM(cov.order_val) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(cov.order_val) AS average_order_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cov.orderid) AS total_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(ipo.items, 0)) AS total_items,
    AVG(rpo.review_score) AS average_review_score
  FROM cust_order_vals cov
  LEFT JOIN items_per_order ipo ON cov.orderid = ipo.order_id
  LEFT JOIN reviews_per_order rpo ON cov.orderid = rpo.order_id
  GROUP BY cov.custuid
) cm
ORDER BY cm.total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
